questions.stem_text: Suppose that there are only two goods: x and y. Which of the following is NOT correct?

options.A: One can have comparative advantage in producing both goods.
options.B: One can have both an absolute advantage and a comparative advantage in producing x.
options.C: One can have absolute advantage and no comparative advantage in producing x.
options.D: One can have comparative advantage and no absolute advantage in producing x.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - One can have comparative advantage in producing both goods.
